cues.text: Eric Clapton wrote Layla about his love for Pattie Boyd, after reading Nizami's Persian tale of Layla and Majnun. Its riff, which Clapton credits to Duane Allman, turns D minor, B flat, C: minor, flat six, flat seven.

sources.title: Derek and the Dominos, Layla (Hooktheory TheoryTab, chords)

cues.text: Lindsey Buckingham's Go Your Own Way, about parting from Stevie Nicks, now rides Layla's band. Its chorus moves D minor, B flat, C.

sources.title: Fleetwood Mac, Go Your Own Way (Hooktheory TheoryTab, chords)

cues.text: Little Red Corvette now rides Fleetwood Mac's band. Prince got the idea dozing in Lisa Coleman's pink Mercury.
It climbs the same three chords: flat six, flat seven, minor. Three bands, one move.

sources.title: Prince, Little Red Corvette (Hooktheory TheoryTab, chords)
